name: nh2f_631g_grad
description: #550's low-symmetry case: NH2F in 6-31G, Cartesian, C1 (the two N-H bonds differ, no atom on an axis, no plane of symmetry). PySCF's converged RHF, libcint's derivative integrals, vj1 / vk1, each per-atom term of the RHF nuclear gradient and its total.

provenance.command: PYTHONPATH=test uv run --group oracle python -m oracle.generate --regenerate nh2f_631g_grad

density_recipe: rhf: PySCF's converged closed-shell RHF density (total, 2 C_occ C_occ^T, symmetrised as (D + D^T) / 2; conv_tol 1e-12, conv_tol_grad 1e-10), recorded; every array is computed from the recorded matrix, which --check holds to 1e-08 of a fresh SCF, not bitwise
